secrets.name: MP_ACCESS_TOKEN
secrets.description: MercadoPago access token (production credentials from MercadoPago > Tus integraciones). Needed for the checkout redirect; without it /api/payment fails and the storefront falls back to WhatsApp transfer.

secrets.name: BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN
secrets.description: Vercel Blob read/write token (Vercel project > Storage > Blob). Needed for admin product-image uploads; without it the storage upload route returns 404.
